answer: A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the whisper graph. Re-attestations are stored in umber and knoll lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 3 dollars and 6 days per identity, which turns a 1665 account sybil into a 9 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
